verdict.rationale: Choosing a model from multiple providers is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents selecting non-Anthropic models. The IAM docs mention signing in through 'a cloud provider', which is an authentication and hosting route, not a choice of model provider. A community comment about using Sonnet instead of Opus implies only a choice among Claude models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers
